title: 36 Hours in Steamboat Springs, Colo.
abstract: If you only know this ski town for its dude ranches and cowboy culture, it’s time to take another look.

title: 36 Hours in Sarasota, Fla.
abstract: Whether you’re seeking flowers or flamenco, paintings or powdery sand, you can find it in this city on the Gulf of Mexico.

title: 36 Hours in Queens, N.Y.
abstract: If you want an alternative New York experience, something with grit and spice, consider Queens, where a splintered world collides in a jumble of diversity.

title: 36 Hours? In Queens, Enough Frugal Options for a Week
abstract: As a companion to his 36 Hours in Queens article, the Frugal Traveler offers his budget-friendly outtakes. And there are plenty.

title: 36 Hours in El Paso, Tex.
abstract: Big views, a lively club scene, a revived theater and even local wineries await visitors to this border city.
